spec_of_record.tracker_row: F-188 'Real-time infrastructure project (transport + presence + rooms for live battle play)' (repo syllabai-v2, Wave 6 - Platform & Commercial, Cycle 2+, Complexity High, P2; validation metric: presence/room stability under load; delivery latency p95 within the 60s battle clock; zero gradebook/learner-state leakage on the wire; the descoped consumer line(s) file and ship on the primitives)
spec_of_record.filing_notes: F-188 Agent Notes of record (ledger main 6f20edd164): INFRASTRUCTURE ONLY — persistent bidirectional transport + presence + room/matchmaking-queue + async-ghost-delivery primitives serving the battle family; nothing matchmaking-, bracket-, or leaderboard-shaped ships under this line; the descoped F-186 territory (descope terms trace 1a169e8c0e52bebd) is this line's downstream consumer and files its own line(s) once the primitives land; design posture carried: battle settlement stays computed-at-read never persisted (ADR-031 posture), zero gradebook surface, ADR-036's accepted on-the-wire k=5 distinct-learner rule governs any class-level surfacing the consumers build
spec_of_record.gates_posture: the matchmaking/brackets gate (ruling trace 1a1693693b033a2d) reads: ADR-036 arm LIFTED (Accepted, ledger PR #45) + realtime-infra arm BUILT (this plane) — the arm lifts when the primitives SERVE in a deployment of record; the consumer filing remains the descoped territory's own next word

transport_choice_of_record.decision: Bun-native WebSocket on a STANDALONE long-lived Bun.serve plane (apps/api/src/realtime/server.ts, path /realtime, REALTIME_PORT default 8081) — deliberately NOT mounted in the Vercel fetch-handler entry
transport_choice_of_record.why: the api's deployment of record is Vercel serverless (index.ts default export = the fetch handler), which cannot hold a persistent bidirectional connection; a standalone long-lived process is the only posture that serves live battle play without inventing a provider dependency
transport_choice_of_record.disclosed: the production hosting decision for the long-lived process is the operator's (any Bun-capable box); local run: bun run dev:realtime; the production latency p95 receipt is the deployed plane's own measurement (the CI battery pins the loopback smoke bound only)

state_posture_of_record.decision: ALL realtime state ephemeral, in-memory, process-local — presence, rooms, queues, pending ghost envelopes (TTL 600s, 64-per-target cap); ZERO database persistence for realtime state; the plane's ONLY database use is the identity revocation lookup at the upgrade (the identity plane, not realtime state)
state_posture_of_record.why: the filed posture verbatim: battle settlement stays computed-at-read never persisted (ADR-031 posture), zero gradebook surface; durability needs are consumer-line territory, disclosed — a restart drops presence/rooms/queues and undelivered envelopes
state_posture_of_record.import_census: Q8b pins the file-level law: protocol.ts + state.ts import NOTHING from db/drill/battle/assessment/identity; server.ts imports the identity law ONLY (R2)

boundary_of_record: R4 — primitives that never decide: transport, presence (userId + counts only), rooms (opaque ids, join/leave/broadcast), queue (dumb FIFO: join/leave/take-oldest-n — a data structure, not a pairing verdict), store-and-forward envelopes (opaque payloads, byte-identical relay, server-stamped sender); no pairing, no rating, no eligibility, no scoring, no bracket logic, no leaderboard anywhere in the module; consumer lines wrap authority laws around their own queue/room naming and their own surfacing (any class-level surfacing is ADR-036 k=5 governed)
